major_cooldowns.name: Takedown
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it with a Tip of the Spear stack ready, or at zero stacks when you play Twin Fangs, and fire your on-use trinket and any external Power Infusion inside the window.
major_cooldowns.id_note: 1250646 is the cast id seen in 5/5 parses and also carries the self buff; 1253859 and 1253862 share the name and were not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Boomstick
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Channel it with a Tip of the Spear stack up, stand so the frontal cone covers the pack, and hold it briefly when adds are about to spawn.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Tooltip base cooldown is 60s; the guide states an effective 45s in single target and as low as 15s in AoE with Lethal Calibration. 1261215 shares the name and was not observed.

major_cooldowns.name: Flamefang Pitch
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Press it once you have room for a full Wildfire Bomb charge of cooldown reduction so none of it is wasted.
major_cooldowns.id_note: Not observed in the sampled parses but castable per its tooltip; the guide lists it as a button in the Pack Leader and Sentinel priorities.

rule.description: Open with pre-pull bomb, Takedown, then Boomstick
rule.action: Throw Wildfire Bomb one global before the pull timer ends, then Harpoon in and send Takedown ahead of Boomstick.

rule.description: Boomstick only with Tip of the Spear
rule.action: Build a stack with Kill Command before you start the channel.

rule.description: Kill Command before Tip of the Spear caps
rule.action: Spend stacks on Raptor Strike, Wildfire Bomb, or Boomstick before you generate more.

rule.description: Kill Command without wasting its Focus
rule.action: Press two spenders between Kill Commands so the Focus it hands you lands in an empty bar.

rule.description: Keep Hunter's Mark on the boss
rule.action: Apply it before the pull and put it straight back up after a target swap.
